EQ-Bench 3 is a multi-turn emotional intelligence benchmark. It assesses active EQ skills, interpersonal skills, psychological insight and analytical depth.
An auxiliary judge model (by default, Claude Opus 4.6) scores or pairwise-compares the outputs.
A judge LLM assigns a multi-criteria rubric score (0–20, scaled up to 0–100) to each scenario outcome, focusing on empathy, emotional reasoning, social skill, etc.
Elo is more discriminative than the scoring rubric (by quite a lot), but also more expensive: around $10-20 in judging costs.

This benchmark does not aim for an absolute definition—only a measure of how well the model responds to intricate social/emotional scenarios under a consistent LLM judge.
